name: SceneEvenTargets
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: Four split low/high target bytes; down/up/right/left order follows DB direction selector.

name: SceneOddTargets
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: Four split low/high target bytes for odd phase.

name: SceneExtraTargets
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: Four split low/high target bytes for extra even-phase work.

name: SelectedSpellObjectTypes
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: Thirteen bytes for selector00..0C; 00/01 map70/72 healing handlers,0C disables slot3. Full spell identities unresolved.

name: HudMaintenanceTargets
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: Six split low/high pointers; valid normal rotation is indexes 01..05, index00 is RTS.

name: SceneInitialCameraXPages
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: 32 initial camera X high bytes; low byte is zero.

name: SceneInitialCameraYScreens
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: 32 initial camera Y screen counts multiplied by F0.

name: ScenePlayerXOffsets
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: 32 player X offsets added to initial camera X.

name: ScenePlayerYOffsets
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: 32 player Y offsets added to initial camera Y; low result decremented once.

name: SceneBank8000Table
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: 32 PRG bank bytes for 03B9 and MMC3 R6.

name: ScenePointerB9Table
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: 32 little-endian pointers loaded into B9/BA; target meaning not inferred from address alone.

name: ScenePointerBBTable
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: 32 little-endian pointers loaded into BB/BC.

name: ScenePointerBFTable
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: 32 little-endian pointers loaded into BF/C0.

name: ScenePointerBDTable
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: 32 little-endian pointers loaded into BD/BE.

name: ScenePointerC1Table
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: 32 little-endian pointers loaded into C1/C2; used by collision path DA3D.

name: ScenePaletteCycleTable
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: 32 bytes loaded into 03BA; downstream palette-cycle encoding not fully reviewed.

name: SceneDirectionFlagsTable
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: 32 DB flag bytes; low direction codes 01 down,03 up,05 right,07 left; bit7 is runtime scroll activity.

name: SceneHorizontalBoundPages
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: 32 bytes loaded into AF; downstream movement compares camera X page.

name: SceneVerticalBoundScreens
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: 32 screen counts multiplied by F0 into AD/AE.

name: ScenePaletteProfilePointers
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: 32 pointers to 27-byte palette/CHR profiles; some targets reside in R7 bank07, others in R6-selected bank.

name: SpecialLayoutArrays
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: 17-entry CHR0, CHR1 and bank/page arrays followed by four arrays of 17 little-endian pointers.

name: CollisionWorkPhaseTargets
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=08 at A000
description: Six low bytes followed by six high bytes; index0 returns, index4 scans pickups directly.

name: CollectibleEffectPointers
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=08 at A000
description: Twenty-four little-endian targets for paired types40/41..6E/6F; twelve entries point to unreviewed A7DB.

name: InitialPlayerStateBytes
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=08 at A000

name: AutomaticCameraStepTargets
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=08 at A000
description: Four split low/high pointers: B073,B07A,B086,B08D.

name: PlayerTableFamilyPointers
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=08 at A000
description: Three two-entry pointer arrays for CHR, metasprites and state handlers; ACF7 input A=0/1 selects family.

name: PlayerNormalChrTable
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=08 at A000
description: 111 CHR bank bytes indexed by CD>>1; table contents identified, not every corresponding state behavior.

name: PlayerNormalSpritePointers
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=08 at A000
description: 111 little-endian metasprite pointers indexed by even CD.

name: PlayerNormalHandlerPointers
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=08 at A000
description: 111 little-endian handler pointers covering CD pairs 00/01 through DC/DD; many handlers remain unreviewed.

name: PlayerAlternateChrTable
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=08 at A000
description: Five CHR bytes for alternate family; precise gameplay activation not assigned.

name: PlayerAlternateSpritePointers
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=08 at A000
description: Five little-endian metasprite pointers for alternate family.

name: PlayerAlternateHandlerPointers
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=08 at A000
description: Five little-endian handler pointers for alternate family.

name: FrontEndObjectXPair
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=09 at A000
description: Two X bytes 1C/E4 copied to 051B/051C by A4B9.

name: FrontEndTilePair
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=09 at A000
description: Two bytes 21/00 used as a PPU transfer source at A585..A599.

name: FrontEndCursorXPair
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=09 at A000
description: Two cursor X bytes 38/88 for selections 00/01.

name: SelectedSpellSpritePointers
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=09 at A000
description: Twelve sprite pointers from generic object table, corresponding to even object types70..86.

name: SelectedSpellHandlerPointers
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=09 at A000
description: Twelve handler pointers; types70/72 target B6BA/B6CD. Remaining target behavior not inferred.

name: NextSceneIndexTable
description: 32-byte successor table; index 1B contains FF end-of-cycle marker.

name: RestartSceneIndexTable
description: 32-byte table used by D178 and D363; physical-stage correspondence unresolved.

name: ContinueSceneIndexTable
description: 32-byte table used by D19A; physical-stage correspondence unresolved.

name: OverlayPalette16
description: 16 palette bytes copied to 0133..0142 and 0153..0162 during Start overlay.

name: CounterZeroCursorPointers
description: Two little-endian cursor pointers selected with 2C*2; pointed data not interpreted.

name: ResetRetainedDefaults
description: Six default bytes copied to 0300..0305; purpose unresolved.

name: PpuTaskPointers
description: 16 little-endian pointers; indices are command&1E divided by 2.

name: YPageCorrectionTable
description: 16 bytes 00,10,...F0 used by Y-coordinate normalization.

name: NextExperienceThresholds
description: Eight four-byte MSD-first base60 decimal thresholds1000..7000,9999 indexed by current level.

name: MaximumMpByLevel
description: Eight three-byte MSD-first base60 decimal maxima100,200,300,400,500,600,700,999.

name: PlayerHpCapacityByIndex
description: Eight raw capacities 40,50,60,70,80,90,A0,B0 indexed by D3&07 on restore; match 4..11 sixteen-unit cells.

name: ExtraAttemptScoreThresholds
description: Six six-byte MSD-first base20 thresholds10000,50000,100000,200000,500000,999999. Last sentinel is not followed by another reviewed threshold.

name: SceneIrqProfileIndex
description: 32 selectors for six IRQ profiles.

name: SceneIrqProfilePointers
description: Six little-endian pointers to F0-terminated latch/index streams.

name: SceneIrqProfiles
description: Six streams; final F0 byte is a terminal latch followed by NMI selector, not an ordinary latch/index pair.

name: SelectedSpellIconTiles
description: Thirteen four-tile glyph groups for06BD0..0C; visual identity not independently rendered.

name: InterruptVectors
description: Little-endian NMI, RESET and IRQ/BRK vectors in the fixed final bank.

name: ChrBankRegisters
description: MMC3 R0..R5 shadow values; each byte is a bank number

name: PpuUploadAddress
description: Little-endian upload destination used by 27-byte stack transfer

name: CameraWorldX
description: Little-endian camera horizontal position; low byte copied into horizontal scroll shadows.

name: CameraWorldY
description: Little-endian camera vertical position in linear pixels; normalized to 240-line pages for PPU shadows.

name: CameraVerticalBound
description: Scene count at B422 multiplied by F0; compared in the downstream vertical movement path.

name: MetaspritePointer
description: Pointer chosen by state table and consumed by both normal and flipped sprite renderers.

name: ScenePointerB9
description: Scene pointer from B282; target can reside in R6 data bank or resident R7 bank07. Full target format unresolved.

name: ScenePointerBB
description: Scene pointer from B2C2. Full target format unresolved.

name: ScenePointerBD
description: Scene pointer from B342. Full target format unresolved.

name: ScenePointerBF
description: Scene pointer from B302. Full target format unresolved.

name: ScenePointerC1
description: Scene pointer from B382; downstream terrain query uses it. Full structure not yet reconstructed.

name: PlayerDispatchTablePointers
description: C3/C4 CHR table; C5/C6 handler table; C7/C8 metasprite table. ACF7 chooses one of two families.

name: PlayerWorldY
description: Player vertical position, initial offset from camera Y. C9 low-byte relative difference drives fall thresholds.

name: PlayerWorldX
description: Player horizontal position; CB/CC minus camera X becomes sprite horizontal origin 24/25.

name: PreviousPlayerPositionSnapshot
description: Copy of C9..CC after player update unless06BD=0B and0593 nonzero.

name: ObjectFrameCounters
description: BE90 increments D8 independently and little-endian D9/DA; D9 parity gates object work/drawing and CHR47.

name: IrqHandlerSource
description: Little-endian source copied to E5/E6 during NMI IRQ setup

name: SharedDispatchPointer
description: Shared little-endian PPU-task/IRQ target; lifetime-dependent meaning

name: PlayerCurrentMpDigits
description: Current MP; additions clamp to F5..F7, spending rolls back on insufficient funds.

name: PlayerExperienceDigits
description: Current experience, cap9999; overflow skips level test and sound request.

name: PlayerNextExperienceThreshold
description: Next threshold from0F:FDA8, values1000..7000 then9999.

name: PlayerMaximumMpDigits
description: Level-dependent MP capacity100..700 then999.

name: PpuUpload27Buffer
description: 27 bytes streamed using temporary SP=00; page is also CPU stack

name: PaletteUploadBuffer
description: 32 bytes streamed using temporary SP=42; page is also CPU stack

name: HudTileStagingBuffer
description: Shared HUD staging: HP-bar phase fills up to11 tiles; level/attempt phase writes icon and numeric glyphs to same buffer.

name: OamDmaBuffer
description: CPU-side OAM buffer; one sprite per four bytes, Y at multiples of 4

name: ResetRetainedBlock
description: Not cleared on reset; first six bytes defaulted when 0100 differs from 68; purpose unresolved

name: PlayerScoreDigits
description: Six score digits capped999999; overflow returns before extra-attempt award checks. Overlaps end of reset-retained0300 block.

name: FarCallTarget
description: Little-endian target CPU address

name: ObjectWorldYLow
description: Low byte of object Y. Parallel arrays have14-hex stride; collectible-relative indexY maps global indexY+3. Runtime scan count remains caller-dependent.

name: ObjectWorldYHigh
description: High byte of object Y. Parallel arrays have14-hex stride; collectible-relative indexY maps global indexY+3. Runtime scan count remains caller-dependent.

name: ObjectWorldXLow
description: Low byte of object X. Parallel arrays have14-hex stride; collectible-relative indexY maps global indexY+3. Runtime scan count remains caller-dependent.

name: ObjectWorldXHigh
description: High byte of object X. Parallel arrays have14-hex stride; collectible-relative indexY maps global indexY+3. Runtime scan count remains caller-dependent.

name: ObjectVelocityX
description: Signed horizontal velocity; flag40 skips integration. Parallel arrays have14-hex stride; collectible-relative indexY maps global indexY+3. Runtime scan count remains caller-dependent.

name: ObjectVelocityY
description: Signed vertical velocity; flag40 skips integration. Parallel arrays have14-hex stride; collectible-relative indexY maps global indexY+3. Runtime scan count remains caller-dependent.

name: ObjectTypeAndFacing
description: Even type indexes sprite/handler pointer tables; bit0 chooses horizontal flip. Parallel arrays have14-hex stride; collectible-relative indexY maps global indexY+3. Runtime scan count remains caller-dependent.

name: ObjectActiveFlags
description: Bit80 active;08 always invokes handler;04 bypasses parity gates;40 skips velocity;20 contributes sprite attribute. Global slot3 is selected effect. Parallel arrays have14-hex stride; collectible-relative indexY maps global indexY+3. Runtime scan count remains caller-dependent.

name: PlayerProgressionFlagBytes
description: Copied into snapshot06CB/06CC and restored. Full bit assignment and pickup unlock path remain unreviewed.

name: LiveProgressionSnapshot
description: Level1, HP1, MP3, EXP4, flags2; copied to06CD..06D7 at run checkpoint. Restored saved HP is then overwritten by full level capacity.

name: SavedRunBlock
description: Saved copy of 06C2..06CC; restored during restart/continue.
